title: Retrieve the logger
story: The scheduler sealed the center aisle. Mica must bring a logger around the obstruction.
objective: Return a valid route to goal using UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT. '#' blocks movement. grid[y][x] is the cell at [x,y]. Trials use open top and bottom aisles joined by one gap.
lesson: Plan three legs: move across the top to the gap in row 1, descend twice, then cross the bottom to the goal. Each test moves the gap.
hint: Find the gap with grid[1].index('.'). Build each horizontal leg using its signed distance.
